statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The diagnosis codes submitted are I47.1, I25.10, and I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-97
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The monitoring is required to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary
